arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle to your own steady race effort.

text: let_go: holding the pack wash takes about 191 W shaft, 26 W over critical power; the pod reserve would empty in about 1.6 km of 5.8 km left.

arguments.text: Let them go now. Ease to your own steady pace.

text: no cue: let_go blocked by the 60 s cooldown; shaft 193 W on the wash vs 172 W sustainable, pod reserve empties in about 1.4 km.

arguments.text: Off the wash now. Ease a touch, settle at 2:29 pace.

text: ease to 2:29: off the wash at 186 W shaft vs 171 W sustainable, pod reserve 56 percent and empties in 1.26 km of 5 km left.

arguments.text: Ease now, into the current. Settle at 3:18, smooth strokes.

text: ease to 3:18 over the ground: pod reserve empty, shaft 197 W vs critical 165 W, fade 5 percent, current against at 0.26 m/s; target is about 159 W.
no cue: shaft power is falling toward critical power (189, 175, now 168 W) and display pace is still faster than the 3:18 target, so the last ease is still settling.

arguments.reason: shaft power held at 170-176 W for 5 min with the pod reserve reading empty, speed through the water steady and fade stable near -6.7 percent: the 165 W test value is low

text: no cue: steady at about 172 W shaft for 5 min with speed holding and the fade stable; raised shaft critical power to 172 W, paddler is pacing well.
no cue: new leg, effort steady at about 173 W shaft, at critical power, speed holding; the paddler is pacing well.

arguments.reason: after holding 172-176 W on an empty reserve for about 6 min the paddler blew up (shaft fell to 139 W, fade -16 percent): the 172 W revision was too high, the tested 165 W fits

arguments.text: Hold this effort, no harder. Save it for the sprint.

text: hold: recovering from a blow-up at 169 W, just over the 165 W critical power (restored after the failed 172 W revision); keep it there to the sprint.
no cue: 167 W shaft vs 170 W sustainable to the finish, pod reserve 24 percent, speed holding; pacing well.

arguments.message: 450 m to go with pod reserve left: cue the finishing sprint now

text: no cue: 168 W shaft at critical power with 17 percent pod reserve and 1 km left; the finish watch needs no fade so it cannot fire, added a pod-reserve sprint watch at 450 m.
no cue: last leg, 168 W shaft near the 172 W sustainable to the finish, pod reserve 17 percent kept for the sprint.

arguments.text: Lift now, steady build to the line. Pace 3:08.

arguments.message: about 200 m to go: cue the all-out finish now

text: push to 3:08: 444 m left into the current with 15 percent pod reserve, enough for about 179 W to the line; all-out finish to be cued at about 200 m.
no cue: already lifting hard at 211 W shaft with the pod reserve at zero and 208 m left; asking for more risks a blow-up before the line.
